note: Every Jev selector calibrated against pairs this session already judged, before being relied on. Ranking and separation matter more than absolute values; two selectors were changed and one withdrawn on this evidence.

within_contract.verdict: usable as a signal, straddles 0.5 correctly

restates_or_adds.verdict: ranks well, calibrates poorly; used as a ranking against a 45-element baseline of reviewed invariants, whose top three are the three where capable reviewers actually objected

decides_a_hole.verdict: withdrawn: needs derivation, and Jev reads rather than derives. The question belongs to a runnable counterexample.

rule_learned: Ask the selector what a text says. Ask the counterexample what the code does. Ask a capable model what a rule implies.
